done_looks_like: End-to-end smoke: running `config-diff examples/a.json examples/b.json` prints a numbered, JSON-path-keyed diff matching `examples/expected-diff.txt`, accepts numeric indices on stdin, writes `a.patched.json` byte-identical to `examples/expected-patched.json`, and exits 0.

Read-only-against-inputs invariant: neither input file is modified on any execution path (success, user-abort, malformed input). Verified by post-run mtime + sha256 equality of both inputs in the smoke test.

Malformed/unreadable input produces a clear diagnostic naming the offending file path AND a JSON parse position when applicable, and exits with non-zero status. Stdout stays parser-friendly (diagnostics go to stderr) so the tool composes into shell pipelines.

MODULE src/config_diff/differ.py (applicability: business-logic). hides_decision: 'how two JSON trees are walked and reconciled into an ordered list of path-keyed DiffEntry records, including which traversal order is canonical for stable user-facing numbering'. Entry-point budget: 1 (`diff_configs(left: Mapping, right: Mapping) -> list[DiffEntry]`). Strategy seam: none (single traversal algorithm; no second impl envisioned). Broad interface: invariants=inputs are treated as immutable and never mutated; ordering=DiffEntry list is returned in deterministic depth-first pre-order over the union of paths so numbering is stable across runs; error_modes=raises ValueError with the offending JSON path when a value is unrepresentable (e.g. set/bytes). Bounded context: config-diff core; no ACL needed (stdlib json types only). Deletion test (optional): removing this module would force the recursive path-walk + diff-classification logic to regrow inside both the CLI command and the applier (the applier needs to know which kind each entry is to apply it correctly).

MODULE src/config_diff/applier.py (applicability: business-logic). hides_decision: 'how a subset of DiffEntry records is applied onto a deep-copied target tree without mutating the original, including how added/removed/changed are reconciled when paths overlap'. Entry-point budget: 1 (`apply_patch(target: Mapping, plan: Sequence[DiffEntry]) -> dict`). Strategy seam: none. Broad interface: invariants=input `target` is never mutated (deep-copied internally); ordering=plan is applied in given order, last-write-wins on conflicting paths; error_modes=raises KeyError-subclass `PatchPathMissing` when a removed/changed entry's path is absent from the target. Bounded context: config-diff core. Deletion test (optional): removing this module would force the path-walk + immutable-update logic to regrow inside the CLI command AND inside any future programmatic consumer (e.g. a future library entry point exposing `apply_patch` for scripted promotion).

MODULE src/config_diff/selector.py (applicability: business-logic). hides_decision: 'how raw user input (numeric tokens, ranges like 1-3, comma lists, blank=none, `a`=all) is parsed into a validated subset of DiffEntry indices, including how invalid tokens are rejected vs ignored'. Entry-point budget: 2 (`render_choices(entries) -> str`, `parse_selection(raw: str, n: int) -> list[int]`). Strategy seam: none. Broad interface: invariants=returned indices are unique, sorted, and all in `[0, n)`; ordering=duplicates and overlapping ranges collapse to a stable sorted set; error_modes=raises `SelectionParseError` with the offending token when input is malformed. Bounded context: config-diff core. Deletion test (optional): removing this module would force the token-parse + range-expansion + bounds-check logic to regrow inside the CLI loop and inside any non-TTY test harness that drives selection programmatically.

MODULE src/config_diff/types.py (applicability: dto — opt-out of C1-C8 per foundation.md §3 row 'Pure data container'). Role: defines the `DiffEntry` dataclass (`path: tuple[str|int, ...]`, `kind: Literal['added','removed','changed']`, `left_value`, `right_value`) and the `PatchPlan = list[DiffEntry]` alias — pure data shapes consumed by differ/applier/selector.

MODULE src/config_diff/cli.py (applicability: framework-shaped — opt-out of C1-C8 per foundation.md §3 row 'Framework-mandated shape (CLI command)'). Role: typer entry point `config-diff <left> <right> [--output PATH]` that loads JSON via stdlib, calls differ, drives selector against stdin, calls applier, writes output; framework conformance outranks deep-module shape here.
